subject: general
question: A is chasing B in the same interval of time. A jumps 8 times, while B jumps 6 times. But the distance covered by A in 7 jumps is the same as that of B in 5 jumps. The ratio between the speeds of A and B is ________.
solution:
Hint:

To put in ratio the values must be of the same unit / same type

Here, jumps will be either for the A or the B.

speed = Distance/ time

∴ speed ∝ distance 

Calculations:

7 jumps of A→ 5 jumps of B

8 jumps of the A → ((5/7) × 8) jumps of the B

= 40/7 jumps of B

∴The required ratio is (40/7) : 6

= 20 : 21

∴ The ratio of the speed of A and B is 20 : 21.
